whoTheyAre.summary: This profile covers the specific PeopleGroups.org record named Bengali Sunni Muslims of Bangladesh, not all Bengalis. The source record uses Bengali (ben) as its primary language.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org classifies this specific source record under Sunni Islam. That classification must not be extended to every Bengali or Bangladeshi individual.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: This profile explains the current source record using provider mission status and documented language/resource context. It does not treat Bengali identity or Islam itself as the cause of the GSEC classification.

whyUnreached.heading: Current mission-status evidence
whyUnreached.summary: PG001156 is currently classified GSEC 2 by PeopleGroups.org.

whyUnreached.heading: Bengali-language resources are documented
whyUnreached.summary: The provider lists Bengali-language Bible and film resources, so the profile does not describe total absence of local-language Christian media.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org identifies PG001156 / PEID 1156 as Bengali Sunni Muslims of Bangladesh with Bengali (ben) as the primary language; Minority Rights Group describes Bengalis as the country's majority ethnolinguistic population and Bangla as the national language.
claims.interpretationNote: PG001156 is one specifically named Bengali Sunni Muslim source record; its religious classification must not be generalized to all Bengalis or all Bangladeshis.

claims.text: Minority Rights Group describes the Bengali Language Movement as an important part of the historical development of Bengali linguistic identity in what became Bangladesh.
claims.interpretationNote: This is broad historical context, not a claim about the political views or identity of every Bengali person.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies PG001156 under Sunni Islam.
claims.interpretationNote: This classification belongs to this named source record and does not describe every Bengali individual's religion.

claims.text: The Bengali Sunni Muslims of Bangladesh record is currently GSEC 2 with the source label 'Less than 2% Evangelical, Dispersed CP Activity.'
claims.interpretationNote: GSEC is the provider's mission-status classification for this source record.

claims.text: The PeopleGroups.org profile lists Bengali-language Bible and film resources associated with this record's language context.
claims.interpretationNote: Resource availability does not establish distribution, comprehension, use, or Scripture translation-completeness.
